# System Architecture Instructions

Start every design discussion by clarifying or stating functional requirements, non-functional requirements, assumptions, scale, and constraints.

Then explain:

1. High-level components
2. Data flow and request lifecycle
3. APIs, data model, or storage choices when relevant
4. Scaling strategy and bottlenecks
5. Availability, consistency, reliability, and failure handling
6. Security, observability, and operational concerns
7. Alternatives and trade-offs

Use diagrams or structured tables when they improve clarity. Keep the design proportional to the stated scale and distinguish confirmed requirements from assumptions. Build basic concepts incrementally toward interview-ready system design.
